prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Interactive flows (new_flow) generated major wins (up to +14.8%), but predictions were often overly optimistic as several variants caused severe drops (down to -11.8%) or rollbacks.
Step reordering (reorder) drove strong wins (up to +12.0%), though predictions overshot as multiple sequence shifts caused severe drops (down to -8.9%) or no clear effect.
UI redesigns (redesign) frequently caused severe performance drops (down to -19.3%), though layout redesigns in later rounds yielded strong wins (up to +8.5%) that outperformed pessimistic predictions.
Wait-state information (wait_info) delivered multiple solid wins (up to +6.1%), though no clear effect was seen for many variants.
Targeted copy updates (copy) achieved selective wins (up to +6.7%), particularly around account retrieval and CTA clarity, though no clear effect was seen for most variants.
Hints, notifications, layout changes, and standalone screens produced no wins, with hints occasionally worsening performance (down to -3.1%) and no clear effect seen for the rest.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Control Practice Sandbox Flow: Adds interactive control practice components to home_intro allowing users to test key shortcuts for calling, hiding, and dragging their desktop pet before launch. (why: Support received 3 emails about post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish step drops to 75.2%.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Display Diagnostics Screen: Inserts a new screen 'new_display_check' before home_intro to verify desktop permissions and overlay rendering before opening the pet. (why: 3 support emails reported that the pet does not show on the desktop or the app will not open upon completing onboarding.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Generation Validation Flow: Adds an interactive image quality selector on upload_photos to help users choose optimal lighting and angle before processing. (why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation failing or rendering improperly during adoption.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Recovery Safeguard Copy: Updates sign_in headline and body to explicitly reassure returning users that signing in restores existing pets and saved progress. (why: 8 support emails (the top support issue) complained of missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Detailed Generation Progress Breakdown: Enables detailed stage progress breakdown and estimated time remaining display on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s and 2 support tickets reported app stalling during asset processing.)
5: [home, notification] Completion Readiness Desktop Notification: Enables background desktop notifications to alert users instantly when companion asset generation finishes. (why: Mean waiting duration is 2336s (over 38 minutes), causing users to switch focus and miss generation completion.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Duration Expectation Hint: Displays a subtle contextual hint on the story screen clarifying onboarding duration and companion creation steps. (why: choose_path conversion is 78.3% with a high mean time of 514s.)
7: [sign_in, incentive] Account Data Safety Guarantee Badge: Adds a visually distinct cloud data protection badge component to sign_in guaranteeing pet retention. (why: Addresses 8 support emails regarding lost or reset pets upon re-authenticating.)
